purpose: Teach: 八つ/裁き/如実/無敵/メリハリ/如き/へそ/爺さん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが八つのおにぎりを作って下さったよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made eight onigiri for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Gentle approval in the voice. A small lift at the mention of his father's effort. Speaking to him like he'll understand the quiet thoughtfulness behind the gesture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、悪い事をしたら裁きを受けるって学んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned that if you do something bad, you get punished for it.
lines.style: Serious and measured, the tone of a child reporting something he's genuinely thought about. Slight emphasis on 'learned'—he's proud of understanding this. No dramatic affect, just steady conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの愛情が如実に伝わるわね
lines.en: Sho, you can really see how much your father loves you in things like that.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. A pause before 'love'—she's noticing something tender and naming it gently. Speaks with quiet certainty, like she's seeing him through his father's eyes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは無敵って思うよ
lines.en: Mom, I think Dad is amazing.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. He says this simply, without embellishment—the certainty of a child who has decided something important. Slight tremor of feeling underneath, but delivered straight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの教えはメリハリがあるわね
lines.en: Sho, your father's lessons really do have... structure to them.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the last phrase. Gentle amusement underneath—she's not saying it unkindly. The tone of someone catching herself noticing something and choosing how to frame it affectionately.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの如き立派な大人になりたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to grow up and be a fine person like Dad.
lines.style: Earnest and straightforward. He means this completely. The formality of 'fine person' comes naturally to him—he's mirroring something he's heard. Delivered with seriousness and quiet ambition.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、温泉でお父さんがへそを出してらしたわよ
lines.en: Sho, at the hot spring your dad was showing off his belly button.
lines.style: Wry amusement barely contained. Slight laugh threaded through the words. Affectionate exasperation—she's caught him doing something undignified and can't help finding it endearing. Delivered with knowing humor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父さんも爺さんって呼ばれて笑ってらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was laughing when they called him 'old man.'
lines.style: Soft, genuine smile in the voice. He's noticed something funny and is sharing it like it's a small, warm secret. The tone of someone who's seen people being silly together and liked it. Light and close.
